summary:
Search and CSV export optimizations were completed and validated, including tenant-scoped chunking, shared embeddings, transactional vector upserts, UTF-8 exports, performance checks, full tests, Ruff, and compile validation. Billing typing progressed: invoice helpers and ledger `post_entry` are annotated, decimal/timezone issues were addressed, and the local full suite passed. A separate invoice-credit regression was identified (`apply_credit` ordering causes a refunded balance to remain too high), though its broader baseline passed 318 tests with 4 skipped.

The PDF async-queue migration is explicitly paused. The new priority is fixing JPY formatting in `ledgerly/money.py` so zero-decimal currencies do not receive two decimal places. Test setup was also refactored with a reusable `make_invoice`, rollback-scoped `db_session`, and `organization_factory`; invoice tests still pass. Profiling shows database setup and repeated payment-history loading as remaining test slowness opportunities.

A GitHub Actions test workflow was created and passed `actionlint`, but CI migration is not committed, pushed, verified, or followed by disabling Travis. Keep commits small. Staging writes must use Redis `cache-eu-3`; `cache-eu-1` is draining.
